preconditions.description: The number of rounds n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 32 and name.islower() and name.isalpha() for name, score in rounds)
preconditions.description: Each name is a string of 1 to 32 lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(-1000 <= score <= 1000 for name, score in rounds)
preconditions.description: Each score is an integer between -1000 and 1000 inclusive.
At the end of the game, at least one player has a positive number of points.

postconditions.description: The output winner is a player who participated in the game.
The winner has the maximum final score among all players.

postconditions.expression: all(final_scores[p] < max(final_scores.values()) or (max_score_reached_at[p] > max_score_reached_at[winner]) for p in final_scores if p != winner)
postconditions.description: Among all players with the maximum final score, the winner is the one who first reached that maximum score value during the game.
